novel_mechanics_found: Level 4's color-8 horizontal assembly is controlled by its small 3x3 right-hand tongue: the tongue is traversable even though it looks like part of the barrier. Entering it from the reachable node at player top-left (32,26) shifts the 5x5 blocker head one 6-cell dock to the right and opens the sealed left shaft. The shift persists only while a body remains on the tongue and snaps back immediately on release, so a committed clone must park there. The color-15 top 3x3 node is also traversable, but parking a clone there produced no visible movement in the two lower color-15 cage/track structures; their exact effect remains unresolved.
narrative: Replayed the resolved 118-action banked prefix using only direct public env.step calls and confirmed levels_completed=3. Explored level 4 from rendered frames, first exhausting several false hypotheses (touching both ends of the blue barrier, synchronized blocked moves, and parking ghosts at the blue ends or the color-15 top node), then discovered that the blue assembly's small tongue can be entered from (32,20) and acts as a hold-to-open control for the left shaft. That discovery came after both clone slots had been irreversibly committed to exploratory endpoints, so the live instance was no longer solvable; a second fresh instance confirmed the trigger but likewise had already spent its slots. Stopped at the budget-safe point and ran the mandatory fresh-reset reproduction gate for level 3, which passed; no additional level win was observed or claimed.
gotchas: The legacy resolved apply_fn polls env._game internally, which is forbidden for this probe; replaying the same 118 labels as one direct public env.step call each reached level 3 cleanly.
A genuinely fresh g50t instance requires a new arc.make(); env.reset() may preserve clone/timer state.
At level 4, approach the blue tongue at player top-left (32,20) and press down to enter it at (32,26); approaching at (26,20), (38,20), or the large left head does not activate it.
Leaving the blue tongue in any direction makes the blocker snap back immediately, so the first committed clone should park on that tongue before another run attempts the opened left shaft.
The right-side upper room is reachable without a mechanism: from (38,20), move up twice, right twice, then down twice to (50,20).
Blocked actions do not advance a replaying ghost; successful active moves do. This matters for timing and makes synchronized blocked-button presses an ineffective strategy.
Clone slots are irreversible within the level. Exploratory commits to (38,20) and the color-15 top node made the tested instances unable to exploit the later blue-tongue discovery.
